title.zh: 卷295 列傳八十二 隆科多 年羹尧 年希尧 胡期恒
title.en: Volume 295 Biographies 82: Long Keduo, Nian Geng Yao, Nian Xi Yao, Hu Qiheng
title.raw: 卷295 列傳八十二 隆科多 年羹尧 年希尧 胡期恒

sentences.zh: 隆科多，佟佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，一等公佟國維子，孝懿仁皇后弟也。

translations.literal: Long Keduo, of the Tunggiya clan, was a man of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, son of first-rank Duke Tong Guowei, and younger brother of Empress Xiaoyiren.
translations.idiomatic: Long Keduo, of the Tunggiya clan, belonged to the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner. He was the son of first-rank Duke Tong Guowei and the younger brother of Empress Xiaoyiren.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十七年，授一等侍衛，擢鑾儀使，兼正藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Kangxi he was appointed a first-class bodyguard, promoted to commissioner of the imperial equipage, and concurrently made Mongol deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 27 he was made a first-class bodyguard, then promoted to commissioner of the imperial equipage and concurrently appointed Mongol deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，以所屬人違法，上責隆科多不實心任事，罷副都統、鑾儀使，在一等侍衛上行走。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, because subordinates under him violated the law, the emperor reproached Long Keduo for not serving wholeheartedly, removed him from deputy lieutenant-general and commissioner of the imperial equipage, and had him serve in the capacity of first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year, when men under his command broke the law, the emperor blamed Long Keduo for lack of diligence, stripped him of his posts as deputy lieutenant-general and commissioner of the imperial equipage, and reduced him to serving as a first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 五十年，授步軍統領。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year he was appointed commander of the metropolitan infantry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year he was appointed commander of the metropolitan infantry.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，擢理籓院尚書，仍管步軍統領。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he was promoted to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, while still supervising the metropolitan infantry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year he was promoted to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs while retaining command of the metropolitan infantry.

sentences.zh: 六十一年十一月，聖祖大漸，召受顧命。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the sixty-first year, when the Kangxi Emperor was gravely ill, Long Keduo was summoned to receive the imperial testament.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Kangxi 61, as the Kangxi Emperor lay dying, he was summoned to receive the dying emperor's testament.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，命與大學士馬齊總理事務，襲一等公，授吏部尚書。

translations.literal: When the Yongzheng Emperor took the throne, he was ordered together with Grand Secretary Ma Qi to oversee affairs of state, inherited the first-rank dukedom, and was appointed minister of the Board of Civil Officials.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongzheng Emperor ascended the throne, Long Keduo was ordered with Grand Secretary Ma Qi to oversee state affairs, inherited the first-rank dukedom, and was appointed minister of the Board of Civil Officials.

sentences.zh: 旋以總理事務勞，加一等阿達哈哈番，以其長子岳興阿襲。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, for his labor in overseeing affairs, he was granted the first-rank addaha han, which his eldest son Yuexing'a inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, for his service in overseeing affairs, he was granted the first-rank addaha han, which his eldest son Yuexing'a inherited.

sentences.zh: 次子玉柱，自侍衛授鑾儀使。

translations.literal: His second son Yuzhu was promoted from bodyguard to commissioner of the imperial equipage.
translations.idiomatic: His second son Yuzhu was promoted from bodyguard to commissioner of the imperial equipage.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，與川陝總督年羹堯同加太保。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he and Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Nian Gengyao were both made grand guardians.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 he and Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Nian Gengyao were both appointed grand guardians.

sentences.zh: 二年，兼領理籓院事。

translations.literal: In the second year he was additionally placed in charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was additionally placed in charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 纂修《聖祖實錄》、《大清會典》並充總裁，監修《明史》。

translations.literal: He compiled the Veritable Records of the Kangxi Emperor and the Collected Statutes of the Great Qing, served as chief compiler, and supervised compilation of the History of the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: He helped compile the Veritable Records of the Kangxi Emperor and the Collected Statutes of the Great Qing as chief compiler, and supervised compilation of the History of the Ming.

sentences.zh: 復與羹堯同賜雙眼花翎、四團龍補服、黃帶、紫轡。

translations.literal: He was again granted together with Gengyao double-eyed peacock feathers, four-claw dragon rank patches, a yellow belt, and a purple bridle.
translations.idiomatic: He again received, together with Gengyao, double-eyed peacock feathers, four-claw dragon rank patches, a yellow belt, and a purple bridle.

sentences.zh: 三年，解步軍統領。

translations.literal: In the third year he was relieved of command of the metropolitan infantry.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was relieved of command of the metropolitan infantry.

sentences.zh: 玉柱以行止甚劣，奪官，交隆科多管束。

translations.literal: Yuzhu, for extremely bad conduct, was stripped of office and placed under Long Keduo's discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Yuzhu was stripped of office for gross misconduct and placed under Long Keduo's supervision.

sentences.zh: 羹堯得罪，上以都統範時捷疏劾欺罔貪婪諸狀，及妄劾道員金南瑛等，並下吏部議處。

translations.literal: When Gengyao fell from favor, because Metropolitan Banner Commander Fan Shijie memorialized impeaching him for deception, greed, and other offenses, and for falsely impeaching circuit intendant Jin Nanying and others, the cases were all referred to the Board of Civil Officials for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: When Gengyao fell from favor, the emperor received a memorial from Metropolitan Banner Commander Fan Shijie charging deception, greed, and other misconduct, as well as false impeachment of Circuit Intendant Jin Nanying and others, and referred all matters to the Board of Civil Officials for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「前以隆科多、年羹堯頗著勤勞，予以異數，乃交結專擅，諸事欺隱。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict saying: "Formerly, because Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao had shown considerable merit, I granted them extraordinary honors; yet they formed factions and monopolized power, deceiving and concealing matters in all respects.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao had earned exceptional favor for their past service, yet they formed factions, monopolized power, and deceived me at every turn.

sentences.zh: 」命繳上所賜四團龍補服，並不得復用雙眼花翎、黃帶、紫轡。

translations.literal: " He ordered them to surrender the four-claw dragon rank patches bestowed by the throne, and forbade them ever again to use double-eyed peacock feathers, the yellow belt, or the purple bridle.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered them to surrender their four-claw dragon rank patches and forbade them ever again to wear double-eyed peacock feathers, the yellow belt, or the purple bridle.

sentences.zh: 及議上，以時捷劾，請罷羹堯任；

translations.literal: When the deliberation was submitted, on the basis of Shijie's impeachment it recommended dismissing Gengyao from office;
translations.idiomatic: When the board reported its findings, it recommended dismissing Gengyao on the basis of Shijie's charges;

sentences.zh: 以妄劾南瑛，請嚴加治罪。

translations.literal: for the false impeachment of Nanying, it recommended severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: and for the false impeachment of Nanying, it recommended severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 上以前議徇庇，後議復過當，責隆科多有意擾亂，削太保及一等阿達哈哈番世職，命往阿蘭善等處修城墾地，諭曰：「朕御極之初，隆科多、年羹堯皆寄以心腹，毫無猜防。

translations.literal: The emperor, because the earlier deliberation had shown favoritism and the later one was again excessive, reproached Long Keduo for deliberately causing disorder, stripped him of grand guardian and the hereditary first-rank addaha han, and ordered him to go to Alashan and other places to build walls and open land for cultivation. He issued an edict saying: "At the beginning of my reign I entrusted Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao with my innermost confidence, without the slightest suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that the first board report had been too lenient and the second too harsh, blamed Long Keduo for deliberately sowing disorder, stripped him of grand guardian and the hereditary first-rank addaha han, and sent him to Alashan and elsewhere to build fortifications and open land. He said: "When I first took the throne I entrusted Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao with my full confidence, without a trace of suspicion.

sentences.zh: 孰知朕視為一德，彼竟有二心，招權納賄，擅作威福，欺罔悖負，朕豈能姑息養奸耶？

translations.literal: Who would have known that while I regarded them as of one virtue, they harbored two hearts, gathered power and accepted bribes, arrogated authority and bestowed favors, deceived and betrayed—how could I indulge and nurture such villains?
translations.idiomatic: Yet while I treated them as loyal to a man, they were divided in heart, gathered power, took bribes, abused their authority, and betrayed me—how could I indulge such men?

sentences.zh: 向日明珠、索額圖結黨行私，聖祖解其要職，置之閒散，何嘗更加信用？

translations.literal: In former days Mingzhu and Songgotu formed factions for private ends; the Kangxi Emperor removed them from key posts and placed them in idle positions—when did he ever trust them again?
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhu and Songgotu once formed factions for private ends; the Kangxi Emperor removed them from key posts and left them idle—he never trusted them again.

sentences.zh: 隆科多、年羹堯若不知恐懼，痛改前非，欲如明珠等，萬不能也！

translations.literal: If Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao do not know fear and thoroughly reform their former errors, to hope to fare like Mingzhu and the others is utterly impossible!
translations.idiomatic: If Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao do not learn fear and mend their ways, they can never hope to fare like Mingzhu and his like!

sentences.zh: 殊典不可再邀，覆轍不可屢蹈，各宜警懼，毋自乾誅滅。

translations.literal: Extraordinary favors cannot be sought again; the same mistakes cannot be trodden repeatedly. Each should be vigilant and fearful, and not bring destruction upon himself.
translations.idiomatic: Extraordinary honors cannot be sought twice, nor the same mistakes repeated. Let each take warning and not court his own ruin.

sentences.zh: 四年，隆科多家僕牛倫挾勢索賕，事發，逮下法司，鞫得隆科多受羹堯及總督趙世顯、滿保，巡撫甘國璧、蘇克濟賄。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Long Keduo's household servant Niulun used his master's power to extort bribes; when the matter came to light he was arrested and handed to the judicial authorities, and interrogation established that Long Keduo had accepted bribes from Gengyao and from governors Zhao Shixian and Manbao, and from governors-general Gan Guobi and Sukeji.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Long Keduo's servant Niulun was found extorting bribes by abusing his master's power. After arrest and trial, Long Keduo was shown to have taken bribes from Gengyao, Governors Zhao Shixian and Manbao, and Governors-General Gan Guobi and Sukeji.

sentences.zh: 讞上，上命斬倫，罷隆科多尚書，令料理阿爾泰等路邊疆事務。

translations.literal: When the verdict was submitted, the emperor ordered Niulun beheaded, removed Long Keduo from the ministry, and ordered him to manage frontier affairs along the Altai and other routes.
translations.idiomatic: When the verdict was reported, the emperor ordered Niulun executed, dismissed Long Keduo as minister, and assigned him to manage frontier affairs along the Altai route and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 尋命勘議俄羅斯邊界。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was ordered to survey and deliberate the Russian border.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to survey and negotiate the Russian border.

sentences.zh: 初，隆科多與阿靈阿、揆敘相黨附，繼又與羹堯交結。

translations.literal: Earlier, Long Keduo had been allied in faction with Aling'a and Kuisu, and later also formed ties with Gengyao.
translations.idiomatic: Long Keduo had first aligned with Aling'a and Kuisu, and later also formed ties with Gengyao.

sentences.zh: 至是，上盡發阿靈阿、揆敘及羹堯罪狀，宣示中外。

translations.literal: At this time the emperor fully disclosed the crimes of Aling'a, Kuisu, and Gengyao and proclaimed them within and without the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor now published the full record of crimes by Aling'a, Kuisu, and Gengyao at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 又侍郎查嗣庭為隆科多所薦，坐悖逆誅死，上詰隆科多，隆科多不以實對。

translations.literal: Moreover, Vice Minister Zha Siting, whom Long Keduo had recommended, was executed for treason; when the emperor questioned Long Keduo, he did not answer truthfully.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Zha Siting, whom Long Keduo had recommended, was executed for treason. When questioned, Long Keduo did not tell the truth.

sentences.zh: 五年，宗人府復奏劾輔國公阿布蘭以玉牒畀隆科多藏於家，阿布蘭坐奪爵幽禁。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Court of the Imperial Clan again memorialized impeaching Assistant Duke Ablan for giving the imperial genealogy to Long Keduo to keep in his house; Ablan was stripped of his title and placed in confinement.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Court of the Imperial Clan reported that Assistant Duke Ablan had given the imperial genealogy to Long Keduo to keep at home. Ablan was stripped of his title and confined.

sentences.zh: 上命奪隆科多爵，召還京，命王大臣會鞫。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Long Keduo's noble rank taken away, summoned him back to the capital, and ordered princes and grand ministers jointly to interrogate him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor stripped Long Keduo of his noble rank, recalled him to the capital, and ordered princes and grand ministers to try him jointly.

sentences.zh: 以聖祖升遐，隆科多未在上前，妄言身藏匕首以防不測；

translations.literal: For when the Kangxi Emperor passed away, Long Keduo was not before the emperor yet falsely claimed he carried a dagger on his person against unforeseen events;
translations.idiomatic: When the Kangxi Emperor died, Long Keduo falsely claimed that though not in the emperor's presence he had carried a dagger against unforeseen danger;

sentences.zh: 又自擬諸葛亮，奏稱「白帝城受命之日，即死期將至之時」；

translations.literal: he also compared himself to Zhuge Liang and memorialized, "The day of receiving the mandate at Baidicheng is the time when death is near";
translations.idiomatic: he compared himself to Zhuge Liang and wrote, "The day one receives the mandate at Baidicheng is the day one's death draws near";

sentences.zh: 上躬祀壇廟，妄謂防刺客，令於案下搜查；

translations.literal: when the emperor personally sacrificed at altars and temples, he falsely spoke of guarding against assassins and ordered searches under the altar tables;
translations.idiomatic: when the emperor sacrificed at the altars and temples, he invented fears of assassins and ordered searches beneath the altar tables;

sentences.zh: 上謁陵，妄奏「諸王心變」。

translations.literal: when the emperor visited the imperial tombs, he falsely memorialized that "the hearts of the princes have changed."
translations.idiomatic: and when the emperor visited the imperial tombs, he falsely reported that "the princes' hearts have turned."

sentences.zh: 具獄辭：大不敬之罪五，欺罔之罪四，紊亂朝政之罪三，黨姦之罪六，不法之罪七，貪婪之罪十六，凡四十一款，當斬，妻子入辛者庫，財產入官。

translations.literal: The completed case record listed: five counts of great irreverence, four of deception, three of disordering court governance, six of factional villainy, seven of lawlessness, and sixteen of greed—forty-one articles in all. The sentence was death; his wife and children were to enter the Sinchi Ward, and his property was to be confiscated by the state.
translations.idiomatic: The indictment listed forty-one counts in all: five of great irreverence, four of deception, three of disordering the court, six of factional villainy, seven of lawlessness, and sixteen of greed. He was sentenced to death, his family to the Sinchi Ward, and his property confiscated.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「隆科多罪不容誅，但皇考升遐，大臣承旨者惟隆科多一人。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict saying: "Long Keduo's crimes deserve death beyond pardon, yet when my late father passed away, among the ministers who received his testament Long Keduo alone was present.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Long Keduo's crimes deserve death, yet when my late father passed away Long Keduo alone among the ministers received his testament.

sentences.zh: 今以罪誅，朕心有所不忍，可免其正法，於暢春園外築屋三楹，永遠禁錮；

translations.literal: Now to execute him for his crimes, my heart cannot bear it. He may be spared formal execution; three rooms shall be built outside the Garden of Refreshing Spring for perpetual imprisonment;
translations.idiomatic: To execute him now would grieve me. Spare him formal execution; build three rooms outside the Garden of Refreshing Spring and imprison him there for life;

sentences.zh: 妻子免入辛者庫，岳興阿奪官，玉柱發黑龍江。

translations.literal: his wife and children shall be spared the Sinchi Ward; Yuexing'a shall be stripped of office, and Yuzhu sent to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: his wife and children shall not enter the Sinchi Ward; Yuexing'a shall be stripped of office, and Yuzhu exiled to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，隆科多死於禁所，賜金治喪。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year Long Keduo died in confinement, and funds were granted for his funeral.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixth year Long Keduo died in confinement, and the court granted funds for his funeral.

sentences.zh: 年羹堯，字亮工，漢軍鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Nian Gengyao, style name Lianggong, was a man of the Chinese Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao, whose style was Lianggong, belonged to the Chinese Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 父遐齡，自筆帖式授兵部主事，再遷刑部郎中。

translations.literal: His father Xialing rose from clerk to director in the Board of War, and was later transferred to director in the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xialing rose from clerk to director in the Board of War and was later transferred to director in the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十二年，授河南道御史。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Kangxi he was appointed censor of the Henan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 22 he was appointed censor of the Henan circuit.

sentences.zh: 四遷工部侍郎，出為湖廣巡撫。

translations.literal: After four promotions he became vice minister of the Board of Works, then went out as governor of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: After four promotions he became vice minister of the Board of Works, then was appointed governor of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 湖北武昌等七府歲徵匠役班價銀千餘，戶絕額缺，為官民累。

translations.literal: In Hubei, Wuchang and six other prefectures annually levied more than a thousand taels in artisan-service class fees; when households died out quotas fell short, becoming a burden on officials and people alike.
translations.idiomatic: In Hubei, Wuchang and six other prefectures levied more than a thousand taels a year in artisan-service fees; extinct households left quotas unfilled, burdening officials and commoners alike.

sentences.zh: 遐齡請歸地丁徵收，下部議，從之。

translations.literal: Xialing requested that collection be folded into the land-and-poll tax; the ministry deliberated and approved.
translations.idiomatic: Xialing asked that the levy be folded into the land-and-poll tax; the ministry approved.

sentences.zh: 疏劾黃梅知縣李錦虧賦，奪官。

translations.literal: He memorialized impeaching Li Jin, magistrate of Huangmei, for tax shortfalls, and Jin was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Li Jin, magistrate of Huangmei, for tax shortfalls, and Jin was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 錦清廉得民，民爭完逋賦，諸生吳士光等聚眾閉城留錦。

translations.literal: Jin was incorrupt and won the people's affection; the people competed to pay arrears, and licentiate Wu Shiguang and others gathered a crowd, closed the city gates, and kept Jin there.
translations.idiomatic: Jin was honest and beloved; the people rushed to pay arrears, and licentiate Wu Shiguang and others gathered a mob, shut the city gates, and refused to let him leave.

sentences.zh: 事聞，上命調錦直隸，士光等發奉天，遐齡與總督郭琇俱降級留任。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor ordered Jin transferred to Zhili, Shiguang and others sent to Fengtian, and both Xialing and Governor Guo Xiu demoted one rank but retained their posts.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne, Jin was transferred to Zhili, Shiguang and his fellows were sent to Fengtian, and both Xialing and Governor Guo Xiu were demoted one rank but kept in office.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，遐齡以病乞休。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year Xialing requested retirement on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year Xialing retired on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 羹堯，康熙三十九年進士，改庶吉士，授檢討。

translations.literal: Gengyao passed the civil examinations in the thirty-ninth year of Kangxi, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed reviser.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao passed the civil examinations in Kangxi 39, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed reviser.

sentences.zh: 迭充四川、廣東鄉試考官，累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: He served in turn as examiner for the Sichuan and Guangdong provincial examinations and was promoted step by step to Hanlin academician of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He served as examiner for the Sichuan and Guangdong provincial examinations in turn and rose to Hanlin academician of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，擢四川巡撫。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year he was promoted to governor of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year he was promoted to governor of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，斡偉生番羅都等掠寧番衛，戕游擊周玉麟。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year the Wo-wei Raw Tribesmen Luo Du and others raided Ningfan Guard and killed Assistant Commander Zhou Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year the Wo-wei Raw Tribesmen under Luo Du raided Ningfan Guard and killed Assistant Commander Zhou Yulin.

sentences.zh: 上命羹堯與提督岳昇龍剿撫。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Gengyao together with Provincial Military Commissioner Yue Shenglong to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Gengyao and Provincial Military Commissioner Yue Shenglong to suppress and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 昇龍率兵討之，擒羅都，羹堯至平番衛，聞羅都已擒，引還。

translations.literal: Shenglong led troops to attack them and captured Luo Du; Gengyao reached Pingfan Guard, heard Luo Du had already been taken, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Shenglong led troops against them and captured Luo Du. Gengyao reached Pingfan Guard, learned Luo Du was already taken, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 川陝總督音泰疏劾，部議當奪官，上命留任。

translations.literal: Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Yintai memorialized impeaching him; the ministry deliberated that he should be stripped of office, but the emperor ordered him retained.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Yintai impeached him; the ministry recommended dismissal, but the emperor let him keep his post.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，越巂衛屬番與普雄土千戶那交等為亂，羹堯遣游擊張玉剿平之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year dependent tribes of Yuexi Guard and Puxiong native chieftain Najiao and others rebelled; Gengyao sent Assistant Commander Zhang Yu to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year tribes under Yuexi Guard and Puxiong native chieftain Najiao rebelled; Gengyao sent Assistant Commander Zhang Yu to put them down.

sentences.zh: 是歲，策妄阿喇布坦遣其將策淩敦多卜襲西藏，戕拉藏汗。

translations.literal: That year Tsewang Araptan sent his general Tsering Dondup to raid Tibet and kill the Dalai Lama's regent Lozang Khan.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tsewang Araptan sent General Tsering Dondup to raid Tibet and kill Regent Lozang Khan.

sentences.zh: 四川提督康泰率兵出黃勝關，兵譁，引還。

translations.literal: Sichuan Provincial Military Commissioner Kang Tai led troops out through Huang Sheng Pass; the troops mutinied and he withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Provincial Military Commissioner Kang Tai led troops through Huang Sheng Pass, but the men mutinied and he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 羹堯遣參將楊盡信撫諭之，密奏泰失兵心，不可用，請親赴松潘協理軍務。

translations.literal: Gengyao sent Brigade Commander Yang Jinxin to pacify them by persuasion, and secretly memorialized that Kang had lost the soldiers' hearts and could not be used, requesting to go in person to Songpan to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sent Brigade Commander Yang Jinxin to pacify the troops and secretly reported that Kang had lost the soldiers' loyalty and should not be used, asking to go in person to Songpan to oversee military affairs.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其實心任事，遣都統法喇率兵赴四川助剿。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his wholehearted service and dispatched Banner Commander Fala with troops to Sichuan to assist in the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his diligence and sent Banner Commander Fala with troops to Sichuan to assist.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，羹堯令護軍統領溫普進駐里塘，增設打箭爐至里塘驛站，尋請增設四川駐防兵，皆允之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year Gengyao ordered Garrison Commander Wenpu to advance and encamp at Litang, added courier stations from Dartsedo to Litang, and soon requested additional garrison troops in Sichuan—all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year Gengyao ordered Garrison Commander Wenpu to advance to Litang, added courier stations from Dartsedo to Litang, and soon won approval for more garrison troops in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 上嘉羹堯治事明敏，巡撫無督兵責，特授四川總督，兼管巡撫事。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Gengyao's clear and keen administration; since governors had no responsibility to command troops, he was specially appointed governor-general of Sichuan and also placed in charge of governorship affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Gengyao's sharp administration. Because governors did not command troops, he was specially made governor-general of Sichuan while retaining governorship duties.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，羹堯以敵情叵測，請赴藏為備。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year Gengyao, because the enemy situation was hard to predict, requested to go to Tibet as a precaution.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year, finding the enemy situation unpredictable, Gengyao asked to go to Tibet as a precaution.

sentences.zh: 廷議以鬆潘諸路軍事重要，令羹堯毋率兵出邊，檄法喇進師。

translations.literal: Court deliberation held that military affairs along the Songpan routes were important and ordered Gengyao not to lead troops beyond the border, while dispatching Fala to advance.
translations.idiomatic: The court held that the Songpan front was critical and ordered Gengyao not to lead troops beyond the border, while dispatching Fala to advance.

sentences.zh: 法喇率副將岳鍾琪撫定里塘、巴塘。

translations.literal: Fala led Deputy Commander Yue Zhongqi to pacify Litang and Batang.
translations.idiomatic: Fala led Deputy Commander Yue Zhongqi to pacify Litang and Batang.

sentences.zh: 羹堯亦遣知府遲維德招降乍丫、察木多、察哇諸番目，因請召法喇師還，從之。

translations.literal: Gengyao also sent Prefect Chi Weide to induce the submission of tribal chiefs of Chaya, Qamdo, and Chawa, and requested that Fala's army be recalled; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao also sent Prefect Chi Weide to win over the chiefs of Chaya, Qamdo, and Chawa, then asked that Fala's army be recalled; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，上命平逆將軍延信率兵自青海入西藏，授羹堯定西將軍印，自拉里會師，並諮羹堯孰可署總督者。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year the emperor ordered Pacification General Yansin to lead troops from Qinghai into Tibet, conferred on Gengyao the seal of Pacifier of the West, and ordered them to join forces at Lhari; he also consulted Gengyao as to who could act as governor in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year the emperor ordered Pacification General Yansin to enter Tibet from Qinghai, gave Gengyao the seal of Pacifier of the West, and ordered a rendezvous at Lhari, while asking whom Gengyao could leave to act as governor.

sentences.zh: 羹堯言一時不得其人，請以將軍印畀護軍統領噶爾弼，而移法喇軍駐打箭爐，上用其議。

translations.literal: Gengyao said that for the moment no suitable man could be found, and requested that the general's seal be given to Garrison Commander Ga'erbi while Fala's army was moved to garrison Dartsedo; the emperor adopted his proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao said no suitable replacement could be found at once and asked that the general's seal go to Garrison Commander Ga'erbi while Fala's army garrisoned Dartsedo; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 巴塘、里塘本雲南麗江土府屬地，既撫定，雲貴總督蔣陳錫請仍隸麗江土知府木興；

translations.literal: Batang and Litang had originally belonged to the native prefecture of Lijiang in Yunnan; once pacified, Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Jiang Chenxi requested they again be placed under Lijiang native prefect Musi;
translations.idiomatic: Batang and Litang had belonged to the Lijiang native prefecture in Yunnan. Once pacified, Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Jiang Chenxi asked that they again be placed under Lijiang native prefect Musi;

sentences.zh: 羹堯言二地為入藏運糧要路，宜屬四川，從之。

translations.literal: Gengyao said the two places were key routes for transporting grain into Tibet and ought to belong to Sichuan; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao argued that both were vital grain routes into Tibet and should belong to Sichuan; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 興率兵往收地，至喇皮，擊殺番酋巴桑，羹堯疏劾。

translations.literal: Musi led troops to recover the territory; at Lapi he attacked and killed tribal chief Basang; Gengyao memorialized impeaching him.
translations.idiomatic: Musi led troops to recover the territory, killed tribal chief Basang at Lapi, and was impeached by Gengyao.

sentences.zh: 上命逮興，囚雲南省城。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Musi arrested and imprisoned in the Yunnan provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Musi arrested and imprisoned in the Yunnan capital.

sentences.zh: 八月，噶爾弼、延信兩軍先後入西藏，策淩敦多卜敗走，西藏平。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the armies of Ga'erbi and Yansin entered Tibet in succession; Tsering Dondup was defeated and fled, and Tibet was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the armies of Ga'erbi and Yansin entered Tibet in turn; Tsering Dondup was defeated and fled, and Tibet was pacified.

sentences.zh: 上諭羹堯護凱旋諸軍入邊，召法喇還京師。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Gengyao to escort the victorious armies back within the border and summoned Fala back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Gengyao to escort the victorious armies back within the border and recalled Fala to the capital.

sentences.zh: 羹堯尋遣兵撫定里塘屬上下牙色、上下雅尼，巴塘屬桑阿壩、林卡石諸生番。

translations.literal: Gengyao soon afterward sent troops to pacify under Litang the Raw Tribes of Upper and Lower Yase and Upper and Lower Yani, and under Batang Sang'aba, Linkashi, and other Raw Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao soon sent troops to pacify the Raw Tribes of Upper and Lower Yase and Yani under Litang, and Sang'aba, Linkashi, and others under Batang.

sentences.zh: 六十年，入覲，命兼理四川陝西總督，辭，還鎮，賜弓矢。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he came to court for audience, was ordered additionally to oversee the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-generalship, declined, returned to his post, and was granted bow and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year he came to court, was offered the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-generalship in addition to his duties, declined, returned to his post, and was granted bow and arrows.

sentences.zh: 上命噶爾弼率兵駐守西藏，行次瀘定橋，噶爾弼病不能行，羹堯以聞。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Ga'erbi to lead troops to garrison Tibet; en route at Luding Bridge Ga'erbi fell ill and could not proceed, and Gengyao reported this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Ga'erbi to garrison Tibet with his troops, but at Luding Bridge Ga'erbi fell too ill to continue, and Gengyao reported it.

sentences.zh: 上命公策旺諾爾佈署將軍，額駙阿寶、都統武格參贊軍務，駐西藏。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Duke Tsewang Norbu to act as resident general, with Imperial Son-in-law Abao and Banner Commander Wuge to assist in military affairs and garrison Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor appointed Duke Tsewang Norbu acting resident general, with Imperial Son-in-law Abao and Banner Commander Wuge to assist in military affairs and garrison Tibet.

sentences.zh: 青海索羅木之西有郭羅克上中下三部，為唐古特種人，屢出肆掠。

translations.literal: West of Suoluomu in Qinghai were the Upper, Middle, and Lower divisions of Golok, Tangut people who repeatedly came out to plunder at will.
translations.idiomatic: West of Suoluomu in Qinghai lay the Upper, Middle, and Lower Golok divisions, Tangut peoples who repeatedly raided at will.

sentences.zh: 阿寶以聞，上令羹堯與鍾琪度形勢，策進討。

translations.literal: Abao reported this; the emperor ordered Gengyao together with Zhongqi to assess the terrain and plan an advance to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Abao reported the raids, and the emperor ordered Gengyao and Zhongqi to survey the terrain and plan an offensive.

sentences.zh: 羹堯疏言：「郭羅克有隘口三，悉險峻，宜步不宜騎。

translations.literal: Gengyao memorialized saying: "Golok has three passes, all steep and perilous, suited to infantry and not to cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao wrote: "Golok has three passes, all steep and narrow—suited to foot soldiers, not cavalry.

sentences.zh: 若多調兵，塞上傳聞，使賊得為備，不如以番攻番。

translations.literal: If many troops are mobilized, word will spread on the frontier and the bandits will be able to prepare; it is better to use tribes against tribes.
translations.idiomatic: If we mobilize many troops, word will spread on the frontier and the enemy will prepare. Better to set tribe against tribe.

sentences.zh: 臣素知瓦斯、雜穀諸土司亦憾郭羅克肆惡，原出兵助剿。

translations.literal: Your servant has long known that the native chiefs of Wasi, Zagun, and other districts also resent Golok's wanton wickedness and are willing to send troops to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: I have long known that the Wasi, Zagun, and other native chiefs also resent Golok's outrages and are willing to send troops to help.

sentences.zh: 臣已移鍾琪令速赴松潘，出塞督土兵進剿。

translations.literal: Your servant has already instructed Zhongqi to hurry to Songpan, go beyond the pass, and supervise native troops in advancing to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: I have already ordered Zhongqi to hurry to Songpan, cross the frontier, and lead native troops against them.

sentences.zh: 」尋，鍾琪督兵擊敗郭羅克，下番寨四十餘，獲其渠，餘眾悉降。

translations.literal: " Shortly afterward Zhongqi supervised troops in defeating Golok, took more than forty tribal stockades, captured their chieftain, and the rest all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon afterward Zhongqi led the campaign, defeated Golok, took more than forty stockades, captured their leader, and the rest surrendered.

sentences.zh: 六十一年，羹堯密疏言：「西藏喇嘛楚爾齊木臧布及知府石如金呈策旺諾爾布委靡，副都統常齡、侍讀學士滿都、員外郎巴特瑪等任意生事，致在藏官兵不睦。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year Gengyao sent a secret memorial saying: "The Tibetan lama Chuerqimu Zangbu and Prefect Shi Rujin reported that Tsewang Norbu was slack and ineffectual, while Deputy Lieutenant-General Chang Ling, Reader-in-Waiting Mandu, Department Director Batma, and others acted arbitrarily and caused discord between officers and soldiers in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixty-first year Gengyao sent a secret memorial: "The Tibetan lama Chuerqimu Zangbu and Prefect Shi Rujin reported that Tsewang Norbu was ineffectual, while Deputy Lieutenant-General Chang Ling, Reader Mandu, Department Director Batma, and others acted arbitrarily, sowing discord among the troops in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 」因請撤駐藏官兵。

translations.literal: " He therefore requested withdrawal of the garrison troops in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore asked that the garrison in Tibet be withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 下廷臣議，以羹堯擅議撤兵，請下部嚴議，上原之，命召滿都、巴特瑪、石如金、楚爾齊木臧布等來京師，遣四​​川巡撫色爾圖、陝西布政使塔琳赴西藏，佐策旺諾爾布駐守。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to court ministers for deliberation; because Gengyao had on his own authority proposed withdrawing troops, they requested severe deliberation by the ministry, but the emperor excused him and ordered Mandu, Batma, Shi Rujin, Chuerqimu Zangbu, and others summoned to the capital, while Sichuan Governor Se'ertu and Shaanxi Provincial Administration Commissioner Talin were sent to Tibet to assist Tsewang Norbu in garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: The court deliberated and, because Gengyao had proposed withdrawal on his own authority, recommended severe censure; the emperor excused him, summoned Mandu, Batma, Shi Rujin, Chuerqimu Zangbu, and others to the capital, and sent Sichuan Governor Se'ertu and Shaanxi Administration Commissioner Talin to Tibet to assist Tsewang Norbu.

sentences.zh: 自軍興，陝西州縣饋運供億，庫帑多虧缺。

translations.literal: Since the war began, Shaanxi prefectures and counties had supplied transport and provisions, and the treasury showed many shortfalls.
translations.idiomatic: Since the war began, Shaanxi's prefectures and counties had supplied transport and provisions, leaving the treasury deeply in deficit.

sentences.zh: 羹堯累疏論劾州縣吏，嚴督追償。

translations.literal: Gengyao repeatedly memorialized impeaching prefectural and county officials and strictly supervised recovery of the shortfalls.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao repeatedly impeached local officials and pressed hard for recovery of the shortfalls.

sentences.zh: 陝西巡撫噶什圖密奏虧項不能速完，又與羹堯請加徵火耗墊補。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Governor Gashetu secretly memorialized that the deficits could not be quickly made up, and together with Gengyao requested additional collection of surcharge fees to cover them.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Governor Gashetu secretly reported that the deficits could not be made up quickly and, together with Gengyao, asked to levy additional surcharge fees to cover them.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「各省錢糧皆有虧空，陝西尤甚。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict saying: "Every province has deficits in tax grain, but Shaanxi is especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Every province has tax deficits, but Shaanxi's are especially grave.

sentences.zh: 蓋自用兵以來，師所經行，資助馬匹、盤費、衣服、食物，倉卒無可措辦，勢必挪用庫帑。

translations.literal: This is because since troops were deployed, wherever the army passed it required support in horses, travel expenses, clothing, and food; with no time to arrange these things, the treasury funds had inevitably to be diverted.
translations.idiomatic: Since the war began, wherever the army passed it needed horses, travel costs, clothing, and food that could not be arranged in haste, so officials inevitably dipped into the treasury.

sentences.zh: 及撤兵時亦然。

translations.literal: The same was true when troops were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The same was true when the troops withdrew.

sentences.zh: 即如自藏回京，將軍以至士卒，途中所得，反多於正項。

translations.literal: For example, on returning from Tibet to the capital, from the general down to the common soldiers, what they obtained along the way was in fact greater than the regular allotments.
translations.idiomatic: Even on the march back from Tibet to the capital, generals and common soldiers alike often took more along the road than their proper allotments.

sentences.zh: 各官費用，動至萬金，但知取用，不問其出自何項也。

translations.literal: Each official's expenses often reached ten thousand taels; they only knew how to draw funds and did not ask from what source they came.
translations.idiomatic: Officials' expenses often ran to ten thousand taels; they drew funds without asking where the money came from.

sentences.zh: 羹堯等欲追虧項以充兵餉，追比不得，又議加徵火耗。

translations.literal: Gengyao and others wished to recover the deficits to cover military pay; unable to collect them by pressing payment, they again proposed increasing surcharge levies.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao and others tried to recover the deficits for military pay but could not collect them in time, and again proposed raising surcharge levies.

sentences.zh: 火耗止可議減，豈可加增？

translations.literal: Surcharges may only be discussed for reduction—how can they be increased?
translations.idiomatic: Surcharges should only be reduced—how can they be increased?

sentences.zh: 朕在位六十一年，從未加徵火耗。

translations.literal: In my sixty-one years on the throne I have never increased surcharge collection.
translations.idiomatic: In my sixty-one years on the throne I have never raised surcharge levies.

sentences.zh: 今若聽其加派，必致與正項一例催徵，肆無忌憚矣。

translations.literal: If they are now allowed to add extra levies, it will inevitably lead to collecting them like regular tax grain, with reckless impunity.
translations.idiomatic: If they are allowed to add extra levies now, surcharges will be collected like regular tax grain, with no restraint at all.

sentences.zh: 著傳旨申飭。

translations.literal: Transmit an edict of stern admonition.
translations.idiomatic: Issue a stern admonition.

sentences.zh: 」命發帑銀五十萬送陝西資餉。

translations.literal: " He ordered five hundred thousand taels from the treasury sent to Shaanxi to supply military funds.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered five hundred thousand taels from the treasury sent to Shaanxi for military supplies.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，召撫遠大將軍允還京師，命羹堯管理大將軍印務。

translations.literal: When the Yongzheng Emperor took the throne, he summoned Pacification General Yunsi back to the capital and ordered Gengyao to manage the great general's seal and affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongzheng Emperor took the throne, he recalled Pacification General Yunsi to the capital and put Gengyao in charge of the great general's seal and affairs.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，授羹堯二等阿達哈哈番世職，並加遐齡尚書銜。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng Gengyao was granted the hereditary second-rank addaha han, and Xialing was given the ministerial rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 Gengyao was granted the hereditary second-rank addaha han, and Xialing was given ministerial rank.

sentences.zh: 尋又加羹堯太保。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Gengyao was again made grand guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao was soon made grand guardian as well.

sentences.zh: 詔撤西藏駐防官軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered withdrawal of the garrison troops in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Tibetan garrison withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 羹堯疏陳邊防諸事，請於打箭爐邊外中渡河口築土城，移嵐州守備駐守；

translations.literal: Gengyao memorialized on frontier defense matters, requesting an earthen fort built at Zhongdu River mouth beyond Dartsedo, with the Lanzhou garrison commander moved to garrison it;
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao memorialized on frontier defense, asking for an earthen fort at Zhongdu River mouth beyond Dartsedo and the Lanzhou garrison commander moved there;

sentences.zh: 大河南保縣，移威茂營千總駐守；

translations.literal: at Dahe in Nanbao County, with a battalion commander from the Weimao garrison moved to hold it;
translations.idiomatic: at Dahe in Nanbao County, with a Weimao battalion commander stationed there;

sentences.zh: 越巂衛地方寥闊，蠻、倮出沒，改設游擊，增兵駐守；

translations.literal: the territory of Yuexi Guard was vast and empty, with Man and Luo tribes coming and going; an assistant commander post was established and more troops garrisoned;
translations.idiomatic: Yuexi Guard's territory was vast and empty, with Man and Luo tribes raiding at will; an assistant commander was appointed and more troops garrisoned;

sentences.zh: 松潘邊外諸番，阿樹為最要，給長官司職銜；

translations.literal: among the tribes beyond Songpan, Ashu was most important and was given the rank of native district chief;
translations.idiomatic: among the tribes beyond Songpan, Ashu was the most important and was given the rank of native district chief;

sentences.zh: 大金川土目莎羅奔從征羊峒有功，給安撫司職銜；

translations.literal: the native chieftain Saloben of Greater Jinchuan had merit in following the campaign at Yangdong and was given the rank of pacification commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Saloben, native chieftain of Greater Jinchuan, earned merit at Yangdong and was given the rank of pacification commissioner;

sentences.zh: 烏蒙蠻目達木等兇暴，土舍祿鼎坤等請擒獻，俟其至，給土職，分轄其地。

translations.literal: the Wumeng tribal head Damu and others were violent; native officer Ludingkun and others requested permission to capture and present them; when they arrived, native offices would be granted and the territory divided for separate jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: the Wumeng chieftain Damu and others were violent; native officer Ludingkun asked to capture and deliver them, after which native offices would be granted and the land divided among them.

sentences.zh: 下部議，從之。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the ministry for deliberation and approved.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 論平西藏功，以羹堯運糧守隘，封三等公，世襲。

translations.literal: In assessing merit for pacifying Tibet, because Gengyao transported grain and guarded passes, he was enfeoffed as third-rank duke, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: For pacifying Tibet, Gengyao was enfeoffed as a hereditary third-rank duke for transporting grain and holding the passes.

sentences.zh: 青海台吉羅卜藏丹津為顧實汗孫，糾諸台吉吹拉克諾木齊、阿爾布坦溫布、藏巴札布等，劫親王察罕丹津叛，掠青海諸部。

translations.literal: Qinghai taiji Lobzang Danjin, grandson of Gushri Khan, rallied the taiji Chilarqenomi, Arbatan Ombo, Zangbazhab, and others, seized Prince Chahan Dorji in rebellion, and plundered the tribes of Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai taiji Lobzang Danjin, grandson of Gushri Khan, rallied Chilarqenomi, Arbatan Ombo, Zangbazhab, and other taiji, seized Prince Chahan Dorji in revolt, and raided the Qinghai tribes.

sentences.zh: 上命羹堯進討，諭撫遠大將軍延信及防邊理餉諸大臣，四川、陝西、雲南督、撫、提、鎮，軍事皆告羹堯。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Gengyao to advance in attack and instructed Pacification General Yansin and the ministers in charge of frontier defense and supplies, and the governors-general, governors, provincial military commissioners, and regional commanders of Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Yunnan, that all military affairs were to be reported to Gengyao.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Gengyao to advance and instructed Pacification General Yansin, frontier ministers, and all military officials of Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Yunnan to report military affairs to Gengyao.

sentences.zh: 十月，羹堯率師自甘州至西寧，改延信平逆將軍，解撫遠大將軍印授羹堯，盡護諸軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Gengyao led his army from Ganzhou to Xining, changed Yansin's title to Pacification General, transferred the Pacification General's seal to Gengyao, and took full command of all armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Gengyao led his army from Ganzhou to Xining, made Yansin Pacification General, gave Gengyao the Pacification General's seal, and took full command of all armies.

sentences.zh: 羹堯請以前鋒統領素丹、提督岳鍾琪為參贊大臣，從之。

translations.literal: Gengyao requested Vanguard Commander Sudan and Provincial Military Commissioner Yue Zhongqi as assisting grand ministers; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao asked that Vanguard Commander Sudan and Provincial Military Commissioner Yue Zhongqi serve as assisting grand ministers; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 論平郭羅克功，進公爵二等。

translations.literal: In assessing merit for pacifying Golok, his dukedom was advanced to second rank.
translations.idiomatic: For pacifying Golok, his dukedom was raised to second rank.

sentences.zh: 羹堯初至西寧，師未集，羅卜藏丹津诇知之，乃入寇，悉破傍城諸堡，移兵向城。

translations.literal: When Gengyao had just reached Xining and the army was not yet assembled, Lobzang Danjin learned of it by reconnaissance, invaded, broke all the nearby forts, and moved his troops toward the city.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao had only just reached Xining when Lobzang Danjin learned the army was not yet assembled, invaded, overran the nearby forts, and marched on the city.

sentences.zh: 羹堯率左右數十人坐城樓不動，羅卜藏丹津稍引退，圍南堡。

translations.literal: Gengyao sat motionless on the city tower with several dozen attendants; Lobzang Danjin slightly withdrew and besieged the southern fort.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sat unmoved on the city tower with a few dozen attendants. Lobzang Danjin drew back slightly and besieged the southern fort.

sentences.zh: 羹堯令兵斫賊壘，敵知兵少，不為備，驅桌子山土番當前隊；

translations.literal: Gengyao ordered troops to attack the enemy stockade; the enemy, knowing the force was small, took no precautions and drove the Zhuozi Mountain tribesmen as the front rank;
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao ordered an attack on the enemy stockade. The enemy, seeing how few troops he had, took no precautions and drove the Zhuozi Mountain tribesmen forward as the vanguard;

sentences.zh: 砲發，土番死者無算。

translations.literal: when the cannon fired, the tribesmen died beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: When the cannon fired, the tribesmen fell beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪兵至，直攻敵營，羅卜藏丹津敗奔，師從之，大潰，僅率百人遁走。

translations.literal: Zhongqi's troops arrived and attacked the enemy camp directly; Lobzang Danjin was defeated and fled, the army pursued, and he was routed utterly, escaping with only a hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi's troops arrived and struck the enemy camp directly. Lobzang Danjin fled in defeat; the army pursued and routed him utterly, and he escaped with only a hundred men.

sentences.zh: 羹堯乃部署諸軍，令總兵官周瑛率兵截敵走西藏路，都統穆森駐吐魯番，副將軍阿喇納出​​噶斯，暫駐布隆吉爾，又遣參將孫繼宗將二千人與阿喇納師會。

translations.literal: Gengyao then deployed the armies, ordering Regional Commander Zhou Ying to lead troops to cut off the enemy's route toward Tibet, Banner Commander Musen to garrison Turfan, Vice General Arna to advance through Gasi and temporarily encamp at Burungir, and Brigade Commander Sun Jizong with two thousand men to join Arna's force.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao then deployed his forces: Regional Commander Zhou Ying to cut off the route to Tibet, Banner Commander Musen to garrison Turfan, Vice General Arna to advance through Gasi and encamp at Burungir, and Brigade Commander Sun Jizong with two thousand men to join Arna.

sentences.zh: 敵侵鎮海堡，都統武格赴援，敵圍堡，戰六晝夜，參將宋可進等赴援，敵敗走，斬六百餘級，獲多巴囊素阿旺丹津。

translations.literal: The enemy invaded Zhenhai Fort; Banner Commander Wuge went to relieve it; the enemy besieged the fort and fought six days and nights; Brigade Commander Song Kejin and others came to relieve; the enemy was defeated and fled; more than six hundred were beheaded, and Tobanangsu Awang Danjin was captured.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy attacked Zhenhai Fort. Banner Commander Wuge relieved it, and after six days and nights of siege Brigade Commander Song Kejin and others arrived. The enemy fled; more than six hundred were killed, and Tobanangsu Awang Danjin was captured.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹津攻西寧南川口，師保申中堡。

translations.literal: Lobzang Danjin attacked Xining's Nanchuan Pass; the army defended Shenzhong Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Danjin attacked Xining's Nanchuan Pass while the army held Shenzhong Fort.

sentences.zh: 敵圍堡，堡內囊素與敵通，欲鑿牆而入。

translations.literal: The enemy besieged the fort; inside, nangso colluded with the enemy and wished to break through the wall to let them in.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy besieged the fort, and inside the nangso colluded with them and tried to break through the wall to admit them.

sentences.zh: 守備馬有仁等力禦，可進等赴援，夾擊，敵敗走，諸囊素助敵者皆殺之。

translations.literal: Garrison Commander Ma Youren and others defended strenuously; Kejin and others came to relieve; attacking from both sides, the enemy was defeated and fled; all nangso who had aided the enemy were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison Commander Ma Youren and others held firm; Kejin and others relieved the fort and attacked from both sides. The enemy fled, and every nangso who had aided them was killed.

sentences.zh: 羹堯先後疏聞，並請副都統花色等將鄂爾多斯兵，副都統查克丹等將歸化土默特兵，總兵馬覿伯將大同鎮兵，會甘州助戰，從之。

translations.literal: Gengyao reported in successive memorials and also requested that Deputy Lieutenant-General Huase lead Ordos troops, Deputy Lieutenant-General Chakdan lead Guihua Tumed troops, and Regional Commander Ma Xibo lead Datong garrison troops to join at Ganzhou to assist in battle; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao reported in successive memorials and asked that Deputy Lieutenant-General Huase lead Ordos troops, Chakdan lead Guihua Tumed troops, and Regional Commander Ma Xibo lead Datong garrison troops to Ganzhou; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 西寧北川、上下北塔蒙回諸眾將起應羅卜藏丹津，羹堯遣千總馬忠孝撫定下北塔三十餘莊。

translations.literal: The Mongol and Muslim peoples of Xining's north river valley and Upper and Lower Beita were rising to join Lobzang Danjin; Gengyao sent Battalion Commander Ma Zhongxiao to pacify more than thirty villages of Lower Beita.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols and Muslims of Xining's north river valley and Upper and Lower Beita rose for Lobzang Danjin; Gengyao sent Battalion Commander Ma Zhongxiao to pacify more than thirty villages of Lower Beita.

sentences.zh: 上北塔未服，忠孝率兵往剿，擒戮其渠，餘眾悉降。

translations.literal: Upper Beita had not submitted; Zhongxiao led troops to suppress them, captured and executed their chieftain, and the rest all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Upper Beita had not submitted. Zhongxiao led troops against them, captured and executed their leader, and the rest surrendered.

sentences.zh: 察罕丹津走河州，羅卜藏丹津欲劫以去。

translations.literal: Chahan Dorji fled to Hezhou; Lobzang Danjin wished to seize him and carry him off.
translations.idiomatic: Chahan Dorji fled to Hezhou, and Lobzang Danjin tried to seize him and carry him off.

sentences.zh: 羹堯令移察罕丹津及其族屬入居蘭州。

translations.literal: Gengyao ordered Chahan Dorji and his clansmen moved to reside in Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao moved Chahan Dorji and his clansmen to Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 青海台吉索諾木達什為羅卜藏丹津誘擒，脫出來歸，羹堯奏聞，命封貝子，令羹堯撫慰。

translations.literal: Qinghai taiji Sonam Dash had been lured and captured by Lobzang Danjin, escaped and came back in submission; Gengyao memorialized this; he was ordered enfeoffed as beile, and Gengyao was told to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai taiji Sonam Dash, lured and captured by Lobzang Danjin, escaped and submitted. Gengyao reported it; the court enfeoffed him as beile and ordered Gengyao to reassure him.

sentences.zh: 敵掠新城堡，羹堯令西寧總兵黃喜林等往剿，斬千五百餘級，擒其渠七，得器械、駝馬、牛羊無算。

translations.literal: The enemy raided Xincheng Fort; Gengyao ordered Xining Regional Commander Huang Xilin and others to suppress them; more than fifteen hundred were beheaded, seven chieftains captured, and weapons, camels, horses, cattle, and sheep taken beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy raided Xincheng Fort. Gengyao sent Xining Regional Commander Huang Xilin and others against them; more than fifteen hundred were killed, seven leaders captured, and countless weapons, camels, horses, cattle, and sheep taken.

sentences.zh: 以天寒，羹堯令引師還西寧。

translations.literal: Because the weather was cold, Gengyao ordered the army withdrawn back to Xining.
translations.idiomatic: With the weather turning cold, Gengyao ordered the army back to Xining.

sentences.zh: 尋策來歲進兵，疏：「請選陝西督標西安、固原、寧夏、四川、大同、榆林綠旗兵及蒙古兵萬九千人，令鍾琪等分將，出西寧、松潘、甘州、布隆吉爾四道進討，分兵留守西寧、甘州、布隆吉爾，並駐防永昌、巴塘、里塘、黃勝關、察木多諸隘。

translations.literal: Soon he planned the next year's advance and memorialized: "Request selection of nineteen thousand Green Banner troops of the Shaanxi governor-general's command at Xi'an, Guyuan, and Ningxia, together with Sichuan, Datong, and Yulin troops and Mongol soldiers, with Zhongqi and others to command them separately, advancing by four routes from Xining, Songpan, Ganzhou, and Burungir, while dividing forces to hold Xining, Ganzhou, and Burungir and garrison the passes at Yongchang, Batang, Litang, Huang Sheng Pass, and Qamdo.
translations.idiomatic: He soon planned the next year's campaign and wrote: "Select nineteen thousand Green Banner troops from Xi'an, Guyuan, Ningxia, Sichuan, Datong, Yulin, and Mongol units, with Zhongqi and others commanding separate columns by four routes from Xining, Songpan, Ganzhou, and Burungir, while holding Xining, Ganzhou, and Burungir and garrisoning Yongchang, Batang, Litang, Huang Sheng Pass, and Qamdo.

sentences.zh: 軍中馬不足，請發太僕寺上都打布孫腦兒孳生馬三千，巴爾庫爾駝一千，仍於甘、涼增買千五百。

translations.literal: Horses in the army were insufficient; request issue of three thousand breeding horses from the Shangdu Dabusunao'er stud of the Court of the Imperial Stud, one thousand Barkol camels, and purchase of another fifteen hundred in Ganzhou and Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Horses were short; he asked for three thousand stud horses from Shangdu Dabusunao'er, one thousand Barkol camels, and fifteen hundred more purchased in Ganzhou and Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 糧米，臣已在西安預買六萬石。

translations.literal: As for grain, your servant has already purchased sixty thousand shi in advance at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: As for grain, I have already bought sixty thousand shi in advance at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 軍中重火器，請發景山所製火藥一百駝，駝以一百八十斤計。

translations.literal: The army relied heavily on firearms; request issue of one hundred camel-loads of powder made at Jingshan, each load reckoned at one hundred eighty jin.
translations.idiomatic: The army relied heavily on firearms; he asked for one hundred camel-loads of powder from Jingshan, each load reckoned at one hundred eighty jin.

sentences.zh: 」下廷議，悉如所請，馬加發千，火藥加發倍所請。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to court deliberation; all requests were granted as asked, with an additional thousand horses issued and double the powder requested.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved all requests, added a thousand horses, and doubled the powder allotment.

sentences.zh: 察罕丹津屬部殺羅卜藏丹津守者來歸，羹堯宣上指，安置四川邊外。

translations.literal: Chahan Dorji's dependent tribes killed Lobzang Danjin's garrison troops and came to submit; Gengyao proclaimed the emperor's intent and settled them beyond the Sichuan border.
translations.idiomatic: Chahan Dorji's followers killed Lobzang Danjin's garrisons and submitted. Gengyao proclaimed the emperor's intent and settled them beyond the Sichuan border.

sentences.zh: 墨爾根戴青拉查卜與羅卜藏丹津合力劫察罕丹津，其子察罕喇卜坦等來歸，羹堯令招拉查卜內附。

translations.literal: Mergen Daiqing Lazhab had joined Lobzang Danjin in seizing Chahan Dorji; his son Chahan Labtan and others came to submit; Gengyao ordered Lazhab induced to come within allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Mergen Daiqing Lazhab had joined Lobzang Danjin in seizing Chahan Dorji. His son Chahan Labtan and others submitted, and Gengyao ordered Lazhab brought in.

sentences.zh: 又有堪布諾門汗，察罕丹津從子也，為塔兒寺喇嘛，叛從敵，糾眾拒戰，至是亦來歸。

translations.literal: There was also Khutuktu Nomon Khan, a nephew of Chahan Dorji, a lama of Ta'er Monastery, who had rebelled and followed the enemy, gathering crowds to resist battle; now he too came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Khutuktu Nomon Khan, a nephew of Chahan Dorji and lama of Ta'er Monastery, had rebelled with the enemy and rallied men to resist; he too now submitted.

sentences.zh: 羹堯數其罪，斬之。

translations.literal: Gengyao enumerated his crimes and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao recited his crimes and executed him.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹津侵布隆吉爾，繼宗與副將潘之善擊敗之。

translations.literal: Lobzang Danjin invaded Burungir; Jizong and Deputy Commander Pan Zhishan defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Danjin invaded Burungir and was defeated by Jizong and Deputy Commander Pan Zhishan.

sentences.zh: 西寧南川塞外郭密九部屢出為盜，羹堯招三部內附。

translations.literal: Beyond Xining's Nanchuan Pass the nine divisions of Gomi repeatedly came out as bandits; Gengyao induced three divisions to submit within allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Xining's Nanchuan Pass the nine Gomi divisions repeatedly raided; Gengyao won three divisions to submission.

sentences.zh: 餘部行掠如故，呈庫、沃爾賈二部尤暴戾。

translations.literal: The remaining divisions raided as before; the Chenku and Wo'erjia divisions were especially violent.
translations.idiomatic: The rest continued raiding as before, especially the Chenku and Wo'erjia divisions.

sentences.zh: 羹堯令鍾琪率瓦斯、雜穀二土司兵至歸德堡，撫定上下寺東策布，督兵進殲呈庫部眾，擒戮沃爾賈部酋，餘並乞降。

translations.literal: Gengyao ordered Zhongqi to lead the native troops of the Wasi and Zagun chiefs to Guide Fort, pacify Upper and Lower Sidongcebu of the monasteries, supervise troops in advancing to annihilate the Chenku division, capture and execute the Wo'erjia chieftain, and the rest all begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sent Zhongqi with Wasi and Zagun native troops to Guide Fort, pacified Upper and Lower Sidongcebu, annihilated the Chenku division, captured and executed the Wo'erjia chief, and the rest surrendered.

sentences.zh: 二年，上以羅卜藏丹津負國，叛不可宥，授鍾琪奮威將軍，趣羹堯進兵。

translations.literal: In the second year the emperor, because Lobzang Danjin had betrayed the state and rebellion could not be pardoned, appointed Zhongqi Striking Might General and urged Gengyao to advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the emperor, holding that Lobzang Danjin's rebellion could not be pardoned, made Zhongqi Striking Might General and urged Gengyao to advance.

sentences.zh: 西寧東北郭隆寺喇嘛應羅卜藏丹津為亂，羹堯令鍾琪及素丹等督兵討之，賊屯哈拉直溝以拒。

translations.literal: The lamas of Guolong Monastery northeast of Xining had joined Lobzang Danjin in rebellion; Gengyao ordered Zhongqi and Sudan and others to supervise troops in attacking them; the rebels encamped at Halazhigou to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Lamas of Guolong Monastery northeast of Xining had joined Lobzang Danjin. Gengyao sent Zhongqi, Sudan, and others against them; the rebels held Halazhigou.

sentences.zh: 師奮入，度嶺三，毀寨十。

translations.literal: The army pressed forward vigorously, crossed three ridges, and destroyed ten stockades.
translations.idiomatic: The army pressed forward, crossed three ridges, and destroyed ten stockades.

sentences.zh: 可進、喜林及總兵武正安皆有斬馘，复毀寨七，焚所居室。

translations.literal: Kejin, Xilin, and Regional Commander Wu Zheng'an all had kills in battle; they again destroyed seven stockades and burned the dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Kejin, Xilin, and Regional Commander Wu Zheng'an all took kills; they destroyed seven more stockades and burned the dwellings.

sentences.zh: 至寺外，賊伏山谷間，聚薪縱火，賊殲焉，殺賊六千餘，毀寺，誅其渠。

translations.literal: Reaching outside the monastery, the rebels lay hidden in the valleys, heaped fuel and set fires, and were annihilated; more than six thousand rebels were killed, the monastery destroyed, and its chieftains executed.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the monastery the rebels hid in the valleys, heaped fuel, and set fires; more than six thousand were killed, the monastery destroyed, and its leaders executed.

sentences.zh: 青海貝勒羅卜藏察罕、貝子濟克濟札布、台吉滾布色卜騰納漢將母妻詣羹堯請內屬，羹堯予以茶葉、大麥，令分居邊上。

translations.literal: Qinghai beile Lobzang Chahan, beizi Jikejizhab, and taiji Gunbusebutengnahan brought their mothers and wives to Gengyao requesting submission within allegiance; Gengyao gave them tea and barley and ordered them settled separately along the border.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai beile Lobzang Chahan, beizi Jikejizhab, and taiji Gunbusebutengnahan brought their families to Gengyao to submit; he gave them tea and barley and settled them along the border.

sentences.zh: 羹堯遣鍾琪、正安、喜林、可進及侍衛達鼐，副將王嵩、紀成斌將六千人深入，留素丹西寧佐治事。

translations.literal: Gengyao dispatched Zhongqi, Zheng'an, Xilin, Kejin, and Bodyguard Dainai, with Deputy Commanders Wang Song and Ji Chengbin leading six thousand men in a deep advance, leaving Sudan at Xining to assist in administration.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sent Zhongqi, Zheng'an, Xilin, Kejin, Bodyguard Dainai, and Deputy Commanders Wang Song and Ji Chengbin with six thousand men deep into enemy country, leaving Sudan at Xining to assist in administration.

sentences.zh: 二月，鍾琪師進次伊克喀爾吉，搜山，獲阿爾布坦溫布，喜林亦得其酋巴珠爾阿喇布坦等。

translations.literal: In the second month Zhongqi's army advanced and encamped at Yikeka'erji, searched the mountains, and captured Arbatan Ombo; Xilin also captured chieftains Bazhu'er Alabutan and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Zhongqi's army encamped at Yikeka'erji, searched the mountains, and captured Arbatan Ombo; Xilin also captured chieftains Bazhu'er Alabutan and others.

sentences.zh: 師復進，羹堯诇知阿岡都番助敵，別遣涼莊道蔣泂等督兵攻之，戮其囊素。

translations.literal: The army advanced again; Gengyao learned by reconnaissance that the Agangdu tribes were aiding the enemy and separately dispatched Liangzhuang Circuit Intendant Jiang Jiong and others to supervise troops in attacking them and killing their nangso.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced again. Gengyao learned the Agangdu tribes were aiding the enemy and sent Liangzhuang Circuit Intendant Jiang Jiong and others against them, killing their nangso.

sentences.zh: 复擊破石門寺喇嘛，殺六百餘人，焚其寺。

translations.literal: They again attacked and defeated the lamas of Shimen Monastery, killed more than six hundred, and burned the monastery.
translations.idiomatic: They again defeated the lamas of Shimen Monastery, killed more than six hundred, and burned the monastery.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪師復進次席爾哈羅色，遣兵攻噶斯，逐吹拉克諾木齊。

translations.literal: Zhongqi's army again advanced and encamped at Xi'erhaluose, dispatched troops to attack Gasi, and drove out Chilarqenomi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi's army encamped at Xi'erhaluose, attacked Gasi, and drove out Chilarqenomi.

sentences.zh: 三月，鍾琪師復進次佈爾哈屯。

translations.literal: In the third month Zhongqi's army again advanced and encamped at Bu'erhatun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Zhongqi's army encamped at Bu'erhatun.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹津所居地曰額母訥布隆吉，鍾琪督兵直入，分兵北防柴旦木，斷往噶斯道。

translations.literal: The place where Lobzang Danjin dwelt was called Emunebulongji; Zhongqi supervised troops in advancing straight in, divided forces to guard Chaidanmu to the north, and cut the route toward Gasi.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Danjin dwelt at Emunebulongji. Zhongqi led a direct advance, detached a force to guard Chaidanmu to the north, and cut the route to Gasi.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹津走烏蘭穆和兒，复走柴旦木，師從之，獲其母阿爾太哈屯及其戚屬等，並男婦、牛羊、駝馬無算。

translations.literal: Lobzang Danjin fled to Ulan Muhe'er, then again fled to Chaidanmu; the army pursued, capturing his mother Altai Hatun and her kin, together with men, women, cattle, sheep, and camels beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Danjin fled to Ulan Muhe'er, then to Chaidanmu. The army pursued and captured his mother Altai Hatun and her kin, with countless men, women, cattle, sheep, and camels.

sentences.zh: 分兵攻烏蘭白克，獲吹拉克諾木齊及助亂八台吉。

translations.literal: Dividing forces to attack Ulan Baike, they captured Chilarqenomi and eight taiji who had aided the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: A detached force attacked Ulan Baike and captured Chilarqenomi and eight taiji who had aided the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 時藏巴扎布已先就擒，羅卜藏丹津以二百餘人遁走。

translations.literal: By then Zangbazhab had already been captured first; Lobzang Danjin escaped with only two hundred-odd men.
translations.idiomatic: Zangbazhab had already been captured; Lobzang Danjin escaped with only two hundred men.

sentences.zh: 青海部落悉平。

translations.literal: The tribes of Qinghai were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The Qinghai tribes were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 論功，進羹堯爵一等，別授精奇尼哈番，令其子斌襲，封遐齡如羹堯爵，加太傅；

translations.literal: In assessing merit, Gengyao's noble rank was advanced to first rank, and he was separately granted jingqini han, which his son Bin inherited; Xialing was enfeoffed at the same rank as Gengyao and made grand tutor;
translations.idiomatic: For his merit Gengyao's rank was raised to first-rank duke and he was granted jingqini han, which his son Bin inherited; Xialing was enfeoffed at the same rank and made grand tutor;

sentences.zh: 並授素丹、可進三等阿達哈哈番，喜林二等阿達哈哈番，按察使王景灝及達鼐、瑛、嵩、成斌拜他喇布勒哈番，提督郝玉麟及正安拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Sudan and Kejin were also granted third-rank addaha han, Xilin second-rank addaha han, Surveillance Commissioner Wang Jinghao together with Dainai, Ying, Song, and Chengbin were granted baitalabule han, and Provincial Military Commissioner Hao Yulin together with Zheng'an were granted tuosala ha.
translations.idiomatic: Sudan and Kejin received third-rank addaha han, Xilin second-rank addaha han, Surveillance Commissioner Wang Jinghao with Dainai, Ying, Song, and Chengbin baitalabule han, and Provincial Military Commissioner Hao Yulin with Zheng'an tuosala ha.

sentences.zh: 阿拉布坦蘇巴泰等截路行劫，羹堯令繼宗往剿，逐至推墨爾，阿拉布坦蘇巴泰將妻子遁走。

translations.literal: Alabutan Subatai and others waylaid travelers on the road; Gengyao ordered Jizong to suppress them, pursued to Tuimo'er, and Alabutan Subatai fled with his wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: Alabutan Subatai and others waylaid travelers; Gengyao sent Jizong against them, pursued to Tuimo'er, and Subatai fled with his family.

sentences.zh: 成斌等搜戮餘賊至梭羅木，擊斬堪布夾木燦垂扎木素。

translations.literal: Chengbin and others searched out and killed remaining bandits as far as Suoluomu and attacked and beheaded Khutuktu Jiamucanchuizhamusu.
translations.idiomatic: Chengbin and others hunted down remaining bandits to Suoluomu and killed Khutuktu Jiamucanchuizhamusu.

sentences.zh: 羹堯遣達鼐及成斌攻布哈色布蘇，獲台吉阿布濟車陳；

translations.literal: Gengyao dispatched Dainai and Chengbin to attack Buhaisebusu and captured taiji Abujichechen;
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sent Dainai and Chengbin against Buhaisebusu and captured taiji Abujichechen;

sentences.zh: 又遣副將岳超龍討平河州塞外鐵布等七十八寨，殺二千一百餘人，得人口、牲畜無算。

translations.literal: he also dispatched Deputy Commander Yue Chaolong to suppress and pacify seventy-eight stockades beyond Hezhou Pass including Tiebu, killing more than twenty-one hundred, and taking people and livestock beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: he also sent Deputy Commander Yue Chaolong to pacify seventy-eight stockades beyond Hezhou Pass, including Tiebu, killing more than twenty-one hundred and taking countless people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 羹堯執吹拉克諾木齊、阿爾布坦溫布、藏巴扎布檻送京師。

translations.literal: Gengyao had Chilarqenomi, Arbatan Ombo, and Zangbazhab placed in the cangue and sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sent Chilarqenomi, Arbatan Ombo, and Zangbazhab to the capital in the cangue.

sentences.zh: 上祭告廟、社、景陵、禦午門受俘。

translations.literal: The emperor offered sacrifices and reported to the ancestral temple, the altar of soil and grain, the Jing Mausoleum, and received the captives at the Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reported to the ancestral temple, the altar of soil and grain, and the Jing Mausoleum, and received the captives at the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 羹堯策防邊諸事，以策妄阿喇布坦遣使乞降，請罷北征師，分駐巴里坤、吐魯番、哈密城、布隆吉爾駐兵守焉，轄以總兵，每營撥餘丁屯赤金衛、柳溝所田；

translations.literal: Gengyao planned frontier defense matters; because Tsewang Araptan had sent envoys begging to surrender, he requested withdrawal of the northern expeditionary army, with divided garrisons at Barkol, Turfan, Hami City, and Burungir placed under regional commanders, and surplus men from each camp allotted to farm fields at Chijin Guard and Liugou Post;
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao planned frontier defense. When Tsewang Araptan sent envoys to surrender, he asked to withdraw the northern expedition, garrison Barkol, Turfan, Hami, and Burungir under regional commanders, and allot surplus camp men to farm at Chijin Guard and Liugou Post;

sentences.zh: 設同知理民事，衛守備理屯糧，游牧蒙古令分居布隆吉爾迤南山中。

translations.literal: sub-prefects were established to manage civil affairs, garrison commanders to manage colony grain, and nomadic Mongols were ordered to settle separately in the mountains south of Burungir.
translations.idiomatic: sub-prefects were to manage civil affairs, garrison commanders colony grain, and nomadic Mongols were to settle in the mountains south of Burungir.

sentences.zh: 寧夏邊外阿拉善以滿洲兵駐防。

translations.literal: Beyond the Ningxia border, Alashan was to be garrisoned by Manchu troops.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Ningxia border, Alashan was to be garrisoned by Manchu troops.

sentences.zh: 上悉從所請。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all that was requested.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all requests.

sentences.zh: 莊浪邊外謝爾蘇部土番據桌子、棋子二山為巢，皆穴地而居，官軍駐其地，奴使之；

translations.literal: Beyond the Zhuanglang border the Xie'ersu tribal people held Zhuozi and Qizi mountains as their lair, all dwelling in cave dwellings; when government troops were stationed there they were enslaved and driven;
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Zhuanglang the Xie'ersu tribes held Zhuozi and Qizi mountains as their lair, living in caves; government troops stationed there enslaved and abused them;

sentences.zh: 兵或縱掠，番御之，盡殲，置不問，番始橫。

translations.literal: when soldiers sometimes plundered at will, the tribes resisted and were annihilated entirely, yet nothing was done about it, and the tribes then grew insolent.
translations.idiomatic: when soldiers plundered at will, the tribes resisted and were wiped out with impunity, and the survivors grew defiant.

sentences.zh: 涼州南崇寺沙馬拉木扎木巴等掠新城張義諸堡。

translations.literal: Shamalamuzhamuba of Chong Monastery south of Liangzhou and others raided Xincheng, Zhangyi, and other forts.
translations.idiomatic: Shamalamuzhamuba of Chong Monastery south of Liangzhou and others raided Xincheng, Zhangyi, and other forts.

sentences.zh: 又有郭隆寺逸出喇嘛，與西寧納硃公寺、朝天堂、加爾多寺諸番相結，糾謝爾蘇部土番謀為亂。

translations.literal: Moreover, lamas who had escaped from Guolong Monastery joined with the tribes of Xining's Nazhugong Monastery, Chaotian Hall, and Ji'erduo Monastery, rallying the Xie'ersu tribal people to plot rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Lamas who had escaped from Guolong Monastery also joined tribes of Nazhugong, Chaotian Hall, and Ji'erduo monasteries near Xining and rallied the Xie'ersu to rebel.

sentences.zh: 羹堯遣鍾琪等督兵討之，納硃公寺喇嘛降。

translations.literal: Gengyao dispatched Zhongqi and others to supervise troops in attacking them; the lamas of Nazhugong Monastery surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sent Zhongqi and others against them; the Nazhugong lamas surrendered.

sentences.zh: 師進次朝天堂，遣成斌、喜林及副將張玉等四道攻加爾多寺，殺數百人，餘眾多入水死，焚其寺。

translations.literal: The army advanced and encamped at Chaotian Hall, dispatched Chengbin, Xilin, and Deputy Commander Zhang Yu and others in four columns to attack Ji'erduo Monastery, killed several hundred, many of the rest drowned in water, and burned the monastery.
translations.idiomatic: The army encamped at Chaotian Hall and sent Chengbin, Xilin, Deputy Commander Zhang Yu, and others in four columns against Ji'erduo Monastery; several hundred were killed, many drowned, and the monastery was burned.

sentences.zh: 游擊馬忠孝、王大勳戰和石溝，王序吉、范世雄戰石門口，泂戰喜逢堡，蘇丹師次旁伯拉夏口，土番偽降，诇之，方置伏，縱兵擊之，所殺傷甚眾。

translations.literal: Assistant Commander Ma Zhongxiao and Wang Daxun fought at Heshigou, Wang Xuji and Fan Shixiong at Shimenkou, Jiong at Xifeng Fort, and Sudan's army encamped at Pangbolaxiakou; the tribes feigned surrender, he learned this by reconnaissance, set an ambush, and released troops to attack; casualties were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Commander Ma Zhongxiao and Wang Daxun fought at Heshigou, Wang Xuji and Fan Shixiong at Shimenkou, Jiang Jiong at Xifeng Fort, and Sudan encamped at Pangbolaxiakou. When the tribes feigned surrender, he learned of it, set an ambush, and struck; casualties were heavy.

sentences.zh: 泂搜剿棋子山，逐賊巴洞溝，土司魯華齡逐賊天王溝，先密寺喇嘛縛其渠阿旺策淩以獻。

translations.literal: Jiong searched and suppressed Qizi Mountain, pursued the bandits to Badonggou, native chief Lu Hualing pursued them to Tianwanggou, and lamas of Xianmi Monastery bound their chieftain Awang Celing and presented him.
translations.idiomatic: Jiong swept Qizi Mountain and pursued the bandits to Badonggou; native chief Lu Hualing pursued them to Tianwanggou, and Xianmi lamas bound their leader Awang Celing and delivered him.

sentences.zh: 師入，轉戰五十餘日，殺土番殆盡。

translations.literal: The army entered and fought for more than fifty days, killing the tribal people nearly to the last.
translations.idiomatic: The army entered and fought for more than fifty days, nearly exterminating the tribes.

sentences.zh: 羹堯以先密寺喇嘛反覆不常，並焚其寺，徙其眾加爾多寺外桌子山；

translations.literal: Gengyao, because the lamas of Xianmi Monastery were inconstant and treacherous, also burned their monastery and moved their people to Zhuozi Mountain outside Ji'erduo Monastery;
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao burned Xianmi Monastery for its lamas' treachery and moved its people to Zhuozi Mountain outside Ji'erduo Monastery;

sentences.zh: 餘眾降，羹堯令隸華齡受約束。

translations.literal: the rest surrendered, and Gengyao ordered them placed under Hualing's restraint.
translations.idiomatic: the rest surrendered and were placed under Hualing's authority.

sentences.zh: 條上青海善後諸事，請以青海諸部編置佐領。

translations.literal: He itemized matters of Qinghai post-pacification and requested that the tribes of Qinghai be organized into assistant banners.
translations.idiomatic: He listed Qinghai post-pacification measures and asked that the Qinghai tribes be organized into assistant banners.

sentences.zh: 三年一入貢，開市那拉薩拉。

translations.literal: Tribute was to be presented once every three years, and a market opened at Nalasala.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute would be presented every three years, and a market opened at Nalasala.

sentences.zh: 陝西、雲南、四川三省邊外諸番，增設衛所撫治。

translations.literal: For the tribes beyond the borders of Shaanxi, Yunnan, and Sichuan, additional guards and posts were established to pacify and govern them.
translations.idiomatic: For tribes beyond Shaanxi, Yunnan, and Sichuan, additional guards and posts were established to govern them.

sentences.zh: 諸廟不得過二百楹，喇嘛不得過三百。

translations.literal: No monastery might exceed two hundred bays, and no monastery might have more than three hundred lamas.
translations.idiomatic: No monastery might exceed two hundred bays or three hundred lamas.

sentences.zh: 西寧北川邊外築邊牆，建城堡。

translations.literal: Beyond Xining's north river valley a frontier wall was built and fortresses established.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Xining's north river valley a frontier wall and fortresses were built.

sentences.zh: 大通河設總兵，鹽池、保安堡及打箭爐外木雅吉達、巴塘、里塘諸路皆設兵。

translations.literal: A regional commander was stationed at the Datong River, and troops were posted at Yanchi, Bao'an Fort, and along the routes beyond Dartsedo to Muyajida, Batang, and Litang.
translations.idiomatic: A regional commander was posted at the Datong River, and troops were stationed at Yanchi, Bao'an Fort, and along routes beyond Dartsedo to Muyajida, Batang, and Litang.

sentences.zh: 發直隸、山西、河南、山東、陝西五省軍罪當遣者，往大通河、布隆吉爾屯田；

translations.literal: Soldiers from Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi whose military crimes warranted banishment were sent to farm colonies at the Datong River and Burungir;
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers from Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi due for military banishment were sent to farm at the Datong River and Burungir;

sentences.zh: 而令鍾琪將四千人駐西寧，撫綏諸番。

translations.literal: while Zhongqi was ordered to lead four thousand men garrisoned at Xining to pacify and reassure the tribes.
translations.idiomatic: while Zhongqi was to garrison four thousand men at Xining to pacify the tribes.

sentences.zh: 下王大臣議行。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to princes and grand ministers for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and grand ministers were ordered to deliberate and implement the plan.

sentences.zh: 十月，羹堯入覲，賜雙眼花翎、四團龍補服、黃帶、紫轡、金幣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Gengyao came to court for audience and was granted double-eyed peacock feathers, four-claw dragon rank patches, a yellow belt, a purple bridle, and gold coins.
